judgment.rationale: Both are P2 (rank 1) Knowledge Objectives under the same Unit 11 'Square, rectangle, and triangle' Key Unit Competence, so grain and type match. Their LCs show a substantive content relation rather than mere repetition: the first decomposes into identifying the properties of a square, rectangle and triangle, while the second decomposes into drawing a square, rectangle and triangle with a ruler.
